bg.$description: Grounds, lowest to highest. Each step is one level of elevation.

canvas.$description: Page. Inside of text fields. Hollow Lifeline marker.

surface.$description: Cards, panels, boxes, the Now Line frame, row hover.

raised.$description: Live row, active nav pill, pressed chip, odd voice rooms, your ladder row.

overlay.$description: Chips on cards, Now Line event blocks, selected segment, done markers, empty bar tracks.

sheet.$description: Mobile action bar and menu sheet.

tertiary.$description: Mono labels, times, freshness, the muted half of a two-tone heading.

accent.$description: The one serif accent phrase per heading, step numbers, rail links. Not body copy.

link.$description: Links in rails and facts lists. Body links stay text colour, underlined.

hairline.$description: Decorative separators between rows and around cards.

hairline-strong.$description: Tag outlines, ghost buttons, chips, fact rules.

control.$description: Any edge a user must see to operate a control. 3:1 or more.

default.$description: Primary action surface, your-RSVP outline, progress fill. One ember surface per view.

ring.$description: 2 px outline, 3 px offset, on every focusable element.

ring-on-accent.$description: Focus inside the ember join band.

live.$description: Live only: an event happening now.

ok.$description: Saved, confirmed, sign-ups open, online, first time, new.

warn.$description: Stale data, reserve position, an estimate that matters.

danger.$description: Errors, a downward ladder move, destructive actions.

rank.$description: Rank-glyph arcs, lit from arc 1. A rank name always sits next to the glyph.

brand.$description: Logo/Icon 1 gradient. Exactly three places: the logo, the Now marker, the bot mark.

elevation.$description: No drop shadows. Elevation is one ground step plus a hairline.

blur.$description: Backdrop blur on sticky and sheet layers.
